subject: Mobile Development
title: Palm webOS: Ahead of Its Time
description: A short lesson to help you apply Palm webOS: Ahead of Its Time.

hook.text: In 2009, Palm launched webOS. Tech reviewers called it the best mobile OS ever made.

buildup.text: Gesture navigation, card-based multitasking, and seamless notifications — all were first on webOS.

discovery.text: Every major feature iOS and Android later copied — swipe gestures, cards — came from webOS.

twist.text: Palm couldn't afford the marketing to compete. HP bought it, then killed it within a year.

climax.text: webOS is the definitive story of a great product that lost to better-funded competitors.

punchline.text: The best OS lost because it was outspent.
